policies.hideEligibility: Every positive cover bonus permits Hide. Lesser cover grants no Stealth circumstance bonus.
policies.manualSneak: Measured movement cost is partitioned into per-action Sneak budgets; each budget spends one action and rolls one secret Stealth check.
policies.combatLimit: A manual path requiring more than three Sneak actions is rejected because extra-action permissions cannot be inferred.
policies.stateCarryover: Every Sneak action starts from the prior action's observer-relative result; a later success cannot improve Observed to Undetected without Hide.
policies.cornerRendering: Exact footprint intersections are submitted to Foundry's native visibility engine so one visible corner can render a greater-cover token while native lighting, range and detection modes remain authoritative.
policies.hiddenAppearance: Observer-relative Hidden uses a client-local PF2e Hidden overlay and does not create a global Actor condition.
